title: 1967 AHSME Problem 16
statement: Let the product \((12)(15)(16),\) each factor written in base \(b,\) equal \(3146\) in base \(b.\) Let \(s=12+15+16,\) each term expressed in base \(b.\) Then \(s,\) in base \(b,\) is:

solutions.text:
The product equation is \[ \begin{aligned} &(b+2)(b+5)(b+6)\\ &\qquad=3b^3+b^2+4b+6. \end{aligned} \] It simplifies to \[ \begin{aligned} b^3-6b^2-24b-27&=0,\\ (b-9)(b^2+3b+3)&=0. \end{aligned} \] Thus the valid base is \(b=9.\) The required sum is \(3b+13=4b+4,\) which is \(44_b.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is B.
hints: Translate the three factors and \(3146_b\) into polynomials in \(b\)
The resulting cubic has the valid base \(b=9\)
